ppt.quote: 1. Neatkarīgi no citiem šīs konvencijas noteikumiem, šajā konvencijā paredzētais atvieglojums netiek piešķirts attiecībā uz ienākuma vai kapitāla veidu, ja, ņemot vērā visus atbilstošos faktus un apstākļus, ir pamats uzskatīt, ka atvieglojuma saņemšana bija viens no jebkuras vienošanās vai darījuma galvenajiem mērķiem, kā rezultātā tieši vai netieši tika saņemts šis atvieglojums, ja vien netiek konstatēts, ka šī atvieglojuma piešķiršana šajos apstākļos ir saskaņā ar šīs konvencijas attiecīgo noteikumu objektu un mērķi.

notes: Protocol of 2 November 2016 (likumi.lv id 1717) in force 2018-09-03; Art. XIV(2)(a): applies to WHT on amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January of the year following EIF -> 2019-01-01 (all rates above). Pre-2019 (original 2002 text, applicable from 2003-01-01): dividends 5% (company holding >=20%) / 15%; interest 10%; royalties 5% (equipment) / 10%. Dividends: exemption also for pension funds and the central bank (Art. 10(3)(b),(c)); Protocol para. 7: refund if the one-year minimum holding period is met after payment. Interest 0% tier (Art. 11(2)(a)) applies only where a company resident in one State pays a company (other than a partnership) of the other State that is the beneficial owner; similarly royalty 0% tier (Art. 12(2)(a)) applies only company-to-company (not partnerships). Interest exempt also for government bonds, central bank, export-credit/government-insured loans, credit sales between unrelated enterprises, pension funds and any bank loans (Art. 11(3)(a)-(f)) - not modelled. Original protocol MFN clauses on interest (renumbered para. 8) and royalties (para. 10) remain. MLI does not apply to this treaty (neither party lists it); the 2016 Protocol inserted a treaty PPT (Art. 22a). MFN: original Protocol para. 6 (renumbered para. 10 by the 2016 Protocol) - Latvia's later convention with Japan (an OECD member; signed 2017-01-18, in force 2017-07-05, WHT effective 2018-01-01; likumi.lv id 1727) provides exclusive residence taxation of royalties (Art. 12(1)), which by the clause applies automatically; royalty exemption recorded from 2019-01-01 (first WHT year of the amended Art. 12; MFN applied to the previous text from 2017-07-05 per the clause). The earlier royalty entries describe the treaty text before the MFN took effect. [curated: dropped ROYALTY tier — MFN 0% (Latvia–Japan) not confirmed by an official notice]
unverified: MFN application: no partner-side official notice confirming the MFN exemption was located (Finland published one for the identical LV-FI clause); start date 2019-01-01 is an interpretation
